name: bode/module-logs
description: Structured JSON logs for Magento 2: every log record and exception as one OpenTelemetry-shaped JSON line with trace and span ids, the emitting class, the cron job or CLI command and structured exception data.

suggest.ext-opentelemetry: With the OpenTelemetry SDK, log lines carry the trace_id and span_id of the current span
suggest.open-telemetry/api: Needed to read the current span for trace_id and span_id
